cards.name: RadialRepeatItems
cards.summary: Collection of Radial Repeat art (Object > Repeat > Radial): live groups that copy source art around a circle. Its add() turns page items into a new radial repeat from a RadialRepeatConfig.
use_for: rosettes and mandala ornaments
clock faces, dials and badge/seal borders
radial icon or petal arrays that stay editable
avoid: when the copies must be independent paths for further editing: expand the repeat first, or duplicate() and rotate() plain paths
scripts that must run on Illustrator builds older than the Repeat scripting API: check typeof RadialRepeatConfig first
cards.how: Collection on Document, Layer and GroupItem: app.activeDocument.radialRepeatItems. add(sourceArt, config) takes the page item(s) to repeat and a RadialRepeatConfig (numberOfInstances, radius, reverseOverlap) and returns a RadialRepeatItem; change it later with item.setRadialConfiguration(config, RadialRepeatUpdate flag such as RADIALALL).

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create radial repeat art from sourceArt + a RadialRepeatConfig; returns the RadialRepeatItem

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: how many radial repeats the container holds

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: fetch a repeat by its Layers-panel name; throws when there is none

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every radial repeat in this container, art included

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the Document / Layer / GroupItem the collection belongs to

gotchas: config must be a RadialRepeatConfig; the type library marks it creatable, so new RadialRepeatConfig() works. COM defaults: numberOfInstances 8, reverseOverlap false, radius -1 (meaning of -1 unverified, likely automatic)
the source art is absorbed into the repeat group, so keep a reference to the returned item, not the old selection (unverified)
removeAll deletes the repeated artwork too, not just the repeat setting

review.changes: how: setRadialConfiguration takes (config, RadialRepeatUpdate); constructor gotcha was '(unverified)': harvest RadialRepeatConfig coclass is 'cancreate'; added its COM defaults; example comment no longer calls the constructor unverified

cards.name: RasterItems
cards.summary: Collection of the embedded bitmap images in a document, layer or group (embedded photos, rasterized art). It has no add(): images arrive by placing and embedding or by rasterizing.
use_for: preflight audit of embedded images (colour space, bit depth, embedded or not)
finding RGB images inside a CMYK print file
batch Image Trace or colorize of embedded bitmaps
avoid: looking for linked images: those are PlacedItems (doc.placedItems), not raster items
cards.how: Collection on Document, Layer and GroupItem: app.activeDocument.rasterItems. Index it or use getByName; each RasterItem exposes imageColorSpace, bitsPerChannel, embedded, status, matrix and trace() / colorize().

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of embedded images in the container

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: fetch an image by its Layers-panel name; throws when missing

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every raster item in the container

gotchas: no add() method: place a file with placedItems and embed it, or rasterize art, to create one
linked images are not listed here, so an audit must walk placedItems as well
doc.rasterItems includes images nested in groups and clipping masks; layer.rasterItems is only that layer's (unverified for nested sublayers)

cards.name: Spots
cards.summary: The document's custom colour definitions (spot and global process colours), the colours behind spot / global swatches. add() creates a new Spot to name and define.
use_for: setting up brand Pantone or spot inks for screen print and packaging
die-line, varnish or white-ink separation plates
global process colours that recolour every use at once
avoid: one-off fills that never need a separation or global edit: assign a CMYKColor / RGBColor directly
cards.how: app.activeDocument.spots. add() returns a new Spot; set its name, color (a CMYKColor / RGBColor / LabColor) and colorType (ColorModel.SPOT or PROCESS). Paint with it by wrapping it in a SpotColor (spot + tint).

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create a new spot / global colour definition

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a spot by name, e.g. "PANTONE 186 C"; throws when missing

gotchas: the [Registration] colour is part of the collection and cannot be deleted or edited (unverified that removeAll skips it rather than throwing)
adding a Spot also adds a matching swatch to doc.swatches (unverified)
getByName throws instead of returning null: wrap lookups in try/catch

cards.name: Stories
cards.summary: Collection of text stories: each story is one run of text that may flow through several threaded text frames. It is read-only (no add); stories appear when text frames are made or threaded.
use_for: exporting or spell-checking each article once even when it spans linked frames
word counts per text block in brochures and menus
finding which frames share one threaded story
avoid: styling or positioning frames: use textFrames for that
cards.how: app.activeDocument.stories (also textFrame.story for one frame's story). Each Story exposes textRange, textFrames, characters, words, paragraphs and lines over its whole flow.

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of separate stories in the document

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: named lookup; stories have no panel name, so indexing is the normal route

gotchas: iterating textFrames counts threaded text once per frame; iterate stories to touch each story once
no add() and no removeAll(): create or delete text through textFrames

cards.name: Swatches
cards.summary: The document's Swatches panel as a collection: process, spot, gradient and pattern swatches. add() creates a swatch; getSelected() returns the swatches selected in the panel.
use_for: building a brand palette into a template
reading the swatches a designer picked to drive a recolour script
cleaning or auditing swatch lists before handoff
avoid: defining a separation ink: create a Spot through doc.spots (a matching swatch should follow, unverified)
cards.how: app.activeDocument.swatches. add() returns a Swatch; set name and color (any Color subclass). getSelected(includeSwatchInGroup) returns an array of the swatches selected in the Swatches panel.

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a swatch by its panel name; throws when missing

key_members.name: getSelected
key_members.use: array of swatches selected in the Swatches panel; pass true to include ones inside groups

gotchas: [None] and [Registration] always come first in the list and cannot be deleted (unverified order)
getSelected returns an array, not a Swatches collection
swatch.color for a spot swatch is a SpotColor, so read .spot.color for the ink's values

review.changes: avoid stated as fact what the Spots card marks unverified (spot adds a swatch); hedged

cards.name: SwatchGroups
cards.summary: Collection of swatch folders (colour groups) in the Swatches panel. add() makes a new group to fill with swatches or spots.
use_for: grouping a brand palette or a colour harmony in the template
exporting a named colour set for a client
reading the colour group a designer selected
avoid: when only one flat palette is needed: plain doc.swatches is simpler
cards.how: app.activeDocument.swatchGroups. add() returns a SwatchGroup; set its name and move swatches in with addSwatch() / addSpot(). getSelected() returns the groups selected in the panel.

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a group by name; throws when missing

key_members.name: getSelected
key_members.use: array of the groups selected in the Swatches panel

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of groups (the default container for ungrouped swatches may count as one, unverified)

gotchas: the first group is the default container for ungrouped swatches (unverified)
deleting a group may delete the swatches inside it (unverified)

review.changes: length stated the default group as fact while the gotcha marks it unverified; hedged

cards.name: SymbolItems
cards.summary: Collection of placed symbol instances in a document, layer or group. add(symbol) places a new instance of a Symbol definition, which stays linked to the master.
use_for: repeating logos, icons or map pins that must update together
light files with many copies (trees, crowds, confetti)
template slots that a script swaps between symbol masters
avoid: copies that each need individual edits: use duplicate() on plain art, or breakLink() the instance
cards.how: Collection on Document, Layer and GroupItem: app.activeDocument.symbolItems. add(symbol) takes a Symbol from doc.symbols and returns a SymbolItem; position it with the PageItem position / translate members.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: place an instance of the given Symbol

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of instances in the container

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find an instance by its Layers-panel name; throws when missing

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all instances in the container (the symbol masters stay)

gotchas: a new instance lands at a default spot (unverified where), so always set position after add()
removeAll removes instances only; masters are in doc.symbols
editing an instance's appearance does not change the master; breakLink() turns it into plain art

cards.name: Symbols
cards.summary: The symbol definitions (masters) in the Symbols panel. add() turns page art into a new symbol; addWith9SliceScaling() does the same with 9-slice scaling guides switched on.
use_for: turning a logo or icon into a reusable master
UI buttons and frames that must scale without stretching corners (9-slice)
building a symbol library for data-driven layouts
avoid: art used once: a symbol adds indirection for nothing
cards.how: app.activeDocument.symbols. add(sourceArt, registrationPoint) returns a Symbol (name it afterwards); registrationPoint is a SymbolRegistrationPoint value such as SYMBOLCENTERPOINT. Place instances with doc.symbolItems.add(symbol).

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create a symbol master from a page item

key_members.name: addWith9SliceScaling
key_members.use: create a master with 9-slice scaling guides enabled

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a master by its Symbols-panel name; throws when missing

gotchas: the source art stays on the artboard as plain art after add(); it is not swapped for an instance as in the UI (unverified)
removing a master that still has instances may expand or delete those instances (unverified)
the 9-slice grid is scriptable too: doc.setSymbol9SliceGrid(index, left, top, right, bottom), read back with getSymbol9SliceGrid(index); doc.isSymbolGuidesEnabled(index) tests the switch

review.changes: gotcha said 9-slice guides can only be set in the UI; Document.setSymbol9SliceGrid / getSymbol9SliceGrid / isSymbolGuidesEnabled exist in the harvest

cards.name: SymmetryRepeatItems
cards.summary: Collection of Mirror Repeat art (Object > Repeat > Mirror): live groups that reflect source art across an axis. add() builds one from page items and a SymmetryRepeatConfig.
use_for: symmetric logos, crests and ornaments
character and face drawing where one half mirrors the other
butterfly, leaf and vase shapes that stay editable
avoid: a one-time flip: duplicate() the art and reflect it with a transform instead
cards.how: Collection on Document, Layer and GroupItem: app.activeDocument.symmetryRepeatItems. add(sourceArt, config) takes the art plus a SymmetryRepeatConfig (axisRotationAngleInRadians) and returns a SymmetryRepeatItem; change it later with item.setSymmetryConfiguration(config, SymmetryRepeatUpdate flag such as SYMMETRYALL).

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create mirror repeat art from sourceArt + a SymmetryRepeatConfig

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of mirror repeats in the container

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find one by its Layers-panel name; throws when missing

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every mirror repeat in the container, art included

gotchas: the axis angle is in radians, measured anti-clockwise from the x-axis; the COM default is 1.57 (a vertical axis)
config must be a SymmetryRepeatConfig; the type library marks it creatable, so new SymmetryRepeatConfig() works
removeAll deletes the art inside the repeats as well

review.changes: how: setSymmetryConfiguration takes (config, SymmetryRepeatUpdate); axis gotcha: added direction and the harvested 1.57 default; constructor no longer unverified (coclass 'cancreate'); example set the axis to PI/2, which is the default; now sets 0 so the call visibly changes something

cards.name: Tags
cards.summary: Name/value tags attached to a page item (and to the document): hidden metadata that saves with the .ai file and is only visible to scripts. add() creates a tag.
use_for: marking template slots ("headline", "price") for a fill script
keeping export ids or SKU numbers on objects
leaving QC flags for a later automated pass
avoid: data a designer must see or edit in the UI: use the object name or the Variables panel
cards.how: pageItem.tags (or app.activeDocument.tags). add() returns a Tag; set its name and value (strings). Read back with getByName(name).value.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create a new tag on the item

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: read a tag by name; throws when it is not there

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of tags on the item

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: strip every tag from the item

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the page item (or document) that owns the tags

gotchas: tag names with spaces or punctuation can throw; use identifier-style names (unverified)
values are stored as strings; convert numbers yourself
getByName throws when the tag is missing: wrap it in try/catch for an optional tag
tags travel only in native .ai / PDF-compatible saves; exports drop them (unverified)

cards.name: TextFonts
cards.summary: Collection of the fonts Illustrator can use (app.textFonts), with lookups by PostScript name, an availability check and the current font name.
use_for: preflighting a template's fonts before filling it
enforcing brand typography in a generated layout
choosing a fallback when a font is missing
avoid: asking for a font by family + style text: look up the PostScript name
cards.how: app.textFonts. getByName(postScriptName) returns a TextFont (family, style, name); assign it to textRange.characterAttributes.textFont. isFontAvailable(name) tests before use; getFontByName(name) returns a substitute when the font is missing.

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: TextFont by PostScript name, e.g. "MyriadPro-Bold"; throws when not installed

key_members.name: isFontAvailable
key_members.use: true when the original font with that name is installed

key_members.name: getFontByName
key_members.use: TextFont by name, or a substitute font when the original is missing

key_members.name: getCurrentFont
key_members.use: name of the current font (the Character panel default, unverified)

gotchas: names are PostScript names (no spaces, hyphen before style), not menu names
getFontByName never fails: it can silently hand back a substitute, so test isFontAvailable first
looping over every font is slow on machines with thousands of fonts
Adobe Fonts that are not activated are not listed (unverified)

cards.name: TextFrameItems
cards.summary: Collection of text frames (point, area and on-path text) in a document, layer or group, with factory methods for each kind: add / pointText, areaText and pathText.
use_for: headlines and labels generated from data
area text body copy inside a shape
text on a curve for badges and seals
finding every text frame for a find/replace pass
avoid: large paragraph layouts with styles and threading across pages: build them in InDesign
cards.how: Collection on Document, Layer and GroupItem, reached as app.activeDocument.textFrames (the class is TextFrameItems). pointText(anchor) makes point text, areaText(pathItem) fills a shape, pathText(pathItem, startT, endT) puts text on a path; then set contents.

key_members.name: pointText
key_members.use: point text at an [x, y] anchor, optional TextOrientation

key_members.name: areaText
key_members.use: area text inside a PathItem; baseFrame threads it after an existing frame

key_members.name: pathText
key_members.use: text on a PathItem between startTValue and endTValue

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: empty point text frame; set contents and position afterwards

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a frame by its Layers-panel name; throws when missing

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of text frames in the container

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every text frame in the container

gotchas: areaText and pathText turn the given path into the text container, so the path's fill/stroke is lost
script y values increase upward, so points below the artboard top have negative y; the origin depends on app.coordinateSystem
baseFrame + postFix thread the new frame to an existing one; omit them for a standalone frame

cards.name: TextRanges
cards.summary: A read-only list of TextRange objects inside a frame, story or range. It is reached as textRanges; each element is a stretch of text that a script can read or style.
use_for: walking mixed-style text to read or normalise its formatting
copying formatting run by run between frames
avoid: word- or character-level work: words / characters give exact units
editing contents while iterating: changing text re-splits the ranges
cards.how: textFrame.textRanges, story.textRanges or textRange.textRanges. Each element is a TextRange with contents, characterAttributes and paragraphAttributes. The split is by runs of identical formatting (unverified).

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of ranges in the list

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: named lookup; ranges have no names, so index the list instead

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the frame, story or range it came from

gotchas: what one element covers (a style run) is unverified; test on a frame with mixed styles before relying on it
no add/removeAll: insert text through words / characters / contents
re-fetch the list after any change to the text

cards.name: Variables
cards.summary: The document's data-driven variables (Window > Variables): named slots of type text, image, visibility or graph that data sets fill in. add() creates a variable.
use_for: name badges, price tags, certificates and product cards from a spreadsheet
social templates where headline, photo and visibility change per record
avoid: a handful of one-off changes: set contents directly with a script instead
cards.how: app.activeDocument.variables. add() returns a Variable; set kind (VariableKind.TEXTUAL / IMAGE / VISIBILITY / GRAPH) and name, then bind it from the art side: textFrame.contentVariable, rasterItem.contentVariable, pageItem.visibilityVariable. doc.importVariables(xml) loads variables plus data sets in one go.

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: find a variable by name; throws when missing

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every variable (art stays, bindings go)

gotchas: binding is done on the page item (contentVariable / visibilityVariable), not on the variable
doc.importVariables overwrites the existing variables and data sets
variable names follow XML naming: no spaces, not starting with a digit (unverified)
doc.variablesLocked = true blocks changes

cards.name: Views
cards.summary: Collection of the window views of a document (zoom, centre point, screen mode of each window). It is read-only; views come from open windows.
use_for: zoom to 100% before a pixel check or screenshot
centring the view on an artboard for a capture
resetting screen mode after automation
avoid: changing the artwork: views only change what is on screen
cards.how: app.activeDocument.views (or doc.activeView for the front window). Each View has zoom, centerPoint, bounds, rotateAngle and screenMode / setScreenMode().

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of windows open on this document

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: named lookup; views are usually indexed instead

gotchas: call app.redraw() after changing zoom or centerPoint or the screen may not update mid-script
use doc.activeView for the front window; the order of doc.views is not documented (unverified)

cards.name: Words
cards.summary: The words of a text frame, story or range; each element is a TextRange covering one word. add() appends a word and addBefore() inserts one.
use_for: highlighting keywords in a headline (colour, weight)
word counts and length checks for copy
building a sentence word by word
avoid: finding phrases that cross word boundaries: search contents and use characters instead
cards.how: textFrame.words, story.words or textRange.words. Index it to get a TextRange per word, then style via characterAttributes or read contents.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create a word with the given contents; ExtendScript lists only contents, the COM signature adds optional relativeObject + insertionLocation, so where it lands is unverified

key_members.name: addBefore
key_members.use: insert a word with the given contents (no description in the harvest: placement inferred from the name)

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: named lookup; index the collection instead

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete every word, emptying the text

gotchas: each element is a TextRange, so formatting goes through characterAttributes
whether add() inserts a separating space is unverified; check the result
punctuation attached to a word may count as part of it (unverified)

review.changes: add was described as 'append'; harvest says only 'Create a word', and COM Add takes optional relativeObject/insertionLocation

cards.name: CMYKColor
cards.summary: A CMYK colour value: cyan, magenta, yellow and black, each 0-100 percent. Assign it to fills, strokes, text, swatches or spot definitions.
use_for: print colour specs from a brand guide
rich black mixes (CMY under full K) for large dark areas
CMYK definitions of spot or global colours
avoid: screen-only work in an RGB document: use RGBColor, since CMYK values get converted anyway
cards.how: var c = new CMYKColor(); set cyan, magenta, yellow, black (0-100); assign to pathItem.fillColor / strokeColor, characterAttributes.fillColor, swatch.color or spot.color.
gotchas: values are percentages 0-100, not 0-1
in an RGB document the colour is converted on assignment, and reading it back gives an RGBColor
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

review.changes: use_for quoted a rich-black recipe (C60 M40 Y40) that is not in the harvest; made generic

cards.name: Color
cards.summary: Abstract parent of every Illustrator colour value (RGBColor, CMYKColor, GrayColor, LabColor, SpotColor, GradientColor, PatternColor, NoColor). It has no members of its own and is never created directly.
use_for: typing: fillColor, strokeColor, swatch.color and spot.color accept any subclass
branching a recolour script on the colour's concrete class
avoid: new Color(): build the concrete subclass you need
cards.how: Not created directly. Properties typed Color return one of the subclasses; test its typename ("RGBColor", "CMYKColor", "SpotColor" ...) and read that subclass's members.

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: no harvested members: it is only the declared type of colour properties; work with the concrete subclass

gotchas: the harvest lists no members, so anything shared lives on the subclasses
the harvest has no creatable class for Color (its COM entry is null, while every subclass has a creatable coclass), so never construct it
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

review.changes: new Color() gotcha firmed up from the harvest's COM data

cards.name: GradientColor
cards.summary: A gradient paint: points at a Gradient (stops and type) and places it on the object with origin, angle, length and highlight settings. Assign it as a fill or stroke.
use_for: gradient backgrounds and buttons
metallic or glossy fills on badges and type
radial glows behind a product
avoid: freeform multi-point colour blends: use a gradient mesh or a Freeform gradient in the UI
expecting angle/origin set here to stick: transform the object's fill instead (see gotchas)
cards.how: var gc = new GradientColor(); gc.gradient = doc.gradients[i] (or a new doc.gradients.add()); assign to fillColor / strokeColor. Stops and type (LINEAR/RADIAL) live on the Gradient object.

key_members.name: origin
key_members.use: start point of the gradient vector

key_members.name: matrix
key_members.use: extra transform picked up when the path was transformed

gotchas: angle and origin set before assignment are often ignored: Illustrator fits the gradient to the object (unverified for 30.2); rotate the fill with pageItem.rotate(angle, false, false, true) to turn only the gradient
colour stops are not here: edit gradient.gradientStops
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

cards.name: GrayColor
cards.summary: A greyscale colour value with one gray component from 0 to 100, read as a percentage of black: 0 is white, 100 is black.
use_for: one-ink black-and-white artwork
neutral tints of black for print
greyscale documents and stamps
avoid: neutral greys in an RGB screen design: use RGBColor with equal channels
cards.how: var g = new GrayColor(); g.gray = 40; assign to fillColor / strokeColor / swatch.color.
gotchas: the scale is ink coverage, so a higher value is darker, the opposite of RGB brightness
in RGB or CMYK documents the value is converted on assignment
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

cards.name: LabColor
cards.summary: A CIE L*a*b* colour value: l (lightness 0-100), a (green to red, -128 to 127) and b (blue to yellow, -128 to 127). It describes colour independent of any device.
use_for: defining spot colours from Pantone or measured Lab values
matching a brand colour measured with a spectrophotometer
avoid: ordinary fills in a CMYK/RGB document: the value is converted to document space on assignment anyway
cards.how: var c = new LabColor(); set l, a, b; most useful as spot.color so the spot keeps its Lab definition (spot.spotKind reads SPOTLAB).
gotchas: assigned straight to a fill it is converted to the document colour mode
on-screen appearance depends on colour settings, so Lab values look slightly different between machines (unverified)
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

cards.name: NoColor
cards.summary: The 'none' colour: assigning it removes a fill or stroke, and reading an unpainted fill or stroke returns it. It has no members.
use_for: outline-only shapes and keylines
removing strokes from imported or traced art
detecting unpainted paths in a preflight
avoid: hiding an object: set hidden or opacity instead
cards.how: pathItem.fillColor = new NoColor(); also works on strokeColor and characterAttributes. Test a colour with typename == "NoColor". PathItem.filled = false / stroked = false do the same job.

key_members.name: NoColor
key_members.use: no harvested members: the constructor new NoColor() is the whole API

gotchas: assigning NoColor to text fill and stroke makes the text invisible but still there
filled / stroked flags and NoColor can disagree on imported art; check both in a preflight (unverified)

cards.name: Pattern
cards.summary: A pattern definition from the Swatches panel (doc.patterns): the named tile that PatternColor paints with. A script can rename or delete it, but not read or edit the tile art.
use_for: looking up a brand pattern by name to apply with PatternColor
renaming or cleaning unused patterns in a template
avoid: building or editing the tile artwork by script: use Object > Pattern > Make in the UI
cards.how: app.activeDocument.patterns[i] or patterns.getByName("Grid"). Paint with it through new PatternColor() + .pattern.

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all patterns of the parent collection

gotchas: the tile contents are not exposed in the DOM
deleting a pattern still used by fills may leave those objects with a different fill (unverified)
doc.patterns.add() exists, but no member sets the tile art, so a script cannot build a usable pattern (what add() produces is unverified)

review.changes: added gotcha: Patterns.add() exists in the harvest but the tile art is not settable

cards.name: PatternColor
cards.summary: A pattern paint: points at a Pattern and sets how the tile sits in the shape (scale, rotation, shift, reflection, shear). Assign it as a fill or stroke.
use_for: textile, wallpaper and packaging fills
halftone or line textures inside shapes
brand pattern backgrounds
avoid: moving the tile after it is applied by editing these values: transform the fill with the PageItem transform flags instead
cards.how: var pc = new PatternColor(); pc.pattern = doc.patterns.getByName("Grid"); assign to fillColor / strokeColor. Transform settings are read from an applied fill.

key_members.name: scaleFactor
key_members.use: [x, y] scale applied to the tile

key_members.name: shearAxis
key_members.use: axis the shear is measured from

key_members.name: matrix
key_members.use: extra transform picked up when the path was transformed

gotchas: the harvest calls scaleFactor 'the fraction to scale the prototype', so [1, 1] is probably full size (unverified); read it from an applied fill first
to scale only the pattern use pageItem.resize(sx, sy, false, true, false) so positions stay put
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

review.changes: scaleFactor gotcha now cites the harvest wording ('fraction')

cards.name: RGBColor
cards.summary: An RGB colour value: red, green and blue, each 0-255. The everyday colour for screen, web and social graphics.
use_for: web and social graphics
UI mockups and icons
colours from hex codes in a brand guide
avoid: print jobs in a CMYK document: give CMYK values so no conversion picks the ink mix
cards.how: var c = new RGBColor(); set red, green, blue (0-255); assign to fillColor / strokeColor / characterAttributes.fillColor / swatch.color.
gotchas: there is no hex property: parse "#RRGGBB" yourself
in a CMYK document the colour is converted on assignment and reads back as CMYKColor
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

cards.name: Spot
cards.summary: One custom colour definition from doc.spots: a name, a colour (CMYK, RGB or Lab) and a type (spot ink, global process or registration). Objects paint with it through a SpotColor.
use_for: Pantone or brand inks for screen print and packaging
technical plates such as die-line, varnish or white ink
global process colours
avoid: painting an object directly with a Spot: wrap it in a SpotColor with a tint
cards.how: app.activeDocument.spots.getByName("Brand Red") or spots.add(). Set name, color and colorType (ColorModel.SPOT / PROCESS / REGISTRATION). spotKind tells whether it is defined in CMYK, RGB or Lab; getInternalColor() returns the component values as an array.

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: the colour's name as shown on the swatch and in separations

key_members.name: color
key_members.use: the defining colour value (CMYKColor / RGBColor / LabColor)

key_members.name: colorType
key_members.use: ColorModel: SPOT (own plate), PROCESS (global CMYK) or REGISTRATION

key_members.name: spotKind
key_members.use: read-only SpotColorKind: SPOTCMYK, SPOTRGB or SPOTLAB

key_members.name: getInternalColor
key_members.use: array of the stored component values

gotchas: colorType PROCESS makes it a global colour that separates into CMYK, not its own plate
the [Registration] spot cannot be edited or removed
removing a spot that is in use converts those fills to process colour (unverified)

cards.name: SpotColor
cards.summary: The paint that uses a Spot colour at a tint (0-100 percent). This is what fillColor holds when an object is painted with a spot or global swatch.
use_for: applying Pantone inks at full strength or as tints
screen-print and packaging separations
global brand colours that update everywhere
avoid: one-off colours that need no separation or global edit: plain CMYKColor / RGBColor
cards.how: var sc = new SpotColor(); sc.spot = doc.spots.getByName("..."); sc.tint = 100; assign to fillColor / strokeColor / characterAttributes.fillColor.
gotchas: the spot must come from the same document's spots (unverified that a foreign spot throws)
the ink's own values live on .spot.color, not here
colour objects are values: changing a colour read from fillColor does nothing until you assign it back

cards.name: Swatch
cards.summary: One swatch from the Swatches panel: a name plus a colour value (process, spot, gradient or pattern paint).
use_for: applying brand colours by name
renaming or re-colouring swatches in a template
reading the palette for a recolour or export script
avoid: defining a separation ink from a swatch: create the Spot in doc.spots
cards.how: app.activeDocument.swatches.getByName("Sky") or swatches[i]. Read or set name and color; assign swatch.color to a fill to paint with it.

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: the swatch name in the panel

key_members.name: color
key_members.use: its colour value: RGBColor / CMYKColor / SpotColor / GradientColor / PatternColor ...

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all swatches of the parent collection

gotchas: for spot swatches color is a SpotColor; its ink values are at color.spot.color
[None] and [Registration] cannot be deleted
renaming a spot swatch may rename the spot as well (unverified)

cards.name: SwatchGroup
cards.summary: One swatch folder (colour group) in the Swatches panel: a name plus the swatches and spots placed in it.
use_for: grouping a brand palette in a template
reading a colour group to drive a recolour script
keeping per-client or per-season palettes apart
avoid: when only a flat list of colours is needed: doc.swatches
cards.how: app.activeDocument.swatchGroups.getByName("Brand") or swatchGroups.add(). addSwatch(swatch) / addSpot(spot) put colours in; getAllSwatches() returns them as an array.

key_members.name: addSwatch
key_members.use: put an existing Swatch into the group

key_members.name: addSpot
key_members.use: put an existing Spot into the group

key_members.name: getAllSwatches
key_members.use: array of the swatches in the group

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all groups of the parent collection

gotchas: addSwatch moves the swatch into the group rather than copying it (unverified)
addSpot takes a Spot, not a SpotColor or Swatch
getAllSwatches returns a plain array

cards.name: DataSet
cards.path: Commands and classes for controling Adobe Illustrator's dynamic publishing behavior/DataSet
cards.summary: One captured data set of the Variables panel: one record of values for the document's variables. display() puts that record onto the artboard; update() re-applies the active data set.
use_for: batch output of name badges, price tags, certificates or social cards, one file per record
checking each record of a data-driven template visually
avoid: filling only a few fields: set contents directly
cards.how: Usually loaded with doc.importVariables(File(xml)), then reached as app.activeDocument.dataSets[i] or doc.activeDataSet. Loop: display() a set, export, move to the next.

key_members.name: display
key_members.use: show this data set's values on the artboard

key_members.name: update
key_members.use: re-apply the active data set's dynamic data to the artboard

gotchas: doc.importVariables replaces existing variables and data sets
text that overflows its frame for a long record is not reported; check each output (unverified)
image variables need the linked files reachable from the paths in the XML

cards.name: Variable
cards.path: Commands and classes for controling Adobe Illustrator's dynamic publishing behavior/Variable
cards.summary: One data-driven variable: a named slot of kind text, image, visibility or graph that page items bind to and data sets fill.
use_for: headline, price and photo slots in templates
show/hide layers per record (visibility variable)
chart data from a data set (graph variable)
avoid: binding from the variable side: there is no such member; bind on the page item
cards.how: app.activeDocument.variables.getByName("headline") or variables.add(). Set kind (VariableKind) and name; bind with textFrame.contentVariable, rasterItem.contentVariable or pageItem.visibilityVariable; pageItems lists the bound art.

key_members.name: kind
key_members.use: VariableKind: TEXTUAL, IMAGE, VISIBILITY, GRAPH (Unknown before it is set)

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: variable name used in the XML data

key_members.name: pageItems
key_members.use: read-only list of the art bound to this variable

gotchas: the kind must match the art: TEXTUAL to text frames, IMAGE to placed or raster images (unverified that a mismatch throws)
the harvest describes pageItems as 'all the artwork in this document'; expect only bound art (unverified)
names must be valid XML names (unverified)

cards.name: ExportForScreensItemToExport
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensItemToExport
cards.summary: Says what doc.exportForScreens writes: a range of artboards, a list of assets from the Asset Export panel, and/or the whole document as one file.
use_for: exporting chosen artboards of a social or app-icon set
exporting Asset Export panel assets by id
one-file export of the whole document
avoid: single-file classic exports: doc.exportFile with ExportType is simpler
cards.how: var what = new ExportForScreensItemToExport(); set artboards / assets / document; pass it as the 4th argument of doc.exportForScreens(folder, type, options, what, prefix).

key_members.name: artboards
key_members.use: artboard range string: 'all' (default), '' for none, or a range like '1-3,5'

key_members.name: assets
key_members.use: array of Asset.assetID numbers from doc.assets (default empty)

key_members.name: document
key_members.use: also export the whole document as one file (default false)

gotchas: artboards defaults to 'all', so set it to '' when you only want assets or the document
artboard numbers in the range are 1-based like the Artboards panel (unverified)
asset ids are doc.assets[i].assetID numbers, not asset names

review.changes: gotcha now names the real member (Asset.assetID); assets key_member names Asset.assetID

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsAVIF
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsAVIF
cards.summary: Settings for AVIF output from Export for Screens: lossless or lossy (quality 0-63), alpha, ICC profile, metadata, anti-aliasing, PPI, matte colour and scale.
use_for: small, high-quality web images with transparency
modern web/app assets where AVIF is supported
avoid: targets that cannot decode AVIF (older email clients, some CMSs): use PNG24 or JPEG options
single-file doc.exportFile(file, ExportType.AVIF, ...): that call takes ExportOptionsAVIF, not this class
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsAVIF(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_AVIF, o, itemToExport, prefix).

key_members.name: losslessCompression
key_members.use: true (default) = lossless; false = lossy with imageQuality

key_members.name: scaleTypeValue
key_members.use: the factor, width/height in px or resolution, per scaleType (default 1)

gotchas: imageQuality tops out at 63, not 100
imageQuality only matters with losslessCompression = false; the default lossless output is large
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

review.changes: added avoid: exportFile with ExportType.AVIF uses the separate ExportOptionsAVIF class

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsJPEG
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsJPEG
cards.summary: Settings for JPEG output from Export for Screens: compression method, progressive scans, anti-aliasing, ICC profile and scale. The quality level is picked by the export type (JPEG100/80/50/20), not here.
use_for: photo-heavy social posts and banners
web hero images where file size matters
client previews
avoid: art that needs transparency or crisp flat colour: use PNG24 / PNG8 / SVG
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsJPEG(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_JPEG80, o, ...). Choose SE_JPEG100 / SE_JPEG80 / SE_JPEG50 / SE_JPEG20 for quality.

key_members.name: progressiveScan
key_members.use: number of progressive scans 3-5 (default 3), PROGRESSIVE only

key_members.name: scaleTypeValue
key_members.use: the factor, width/height in px or resolution, per scaleType (default 1)

gotchas: there is no quality member: the quality comes from the ExportForScreensType you pass
JPEG has no transparency, so transparent areas come out on white (unverified colour)
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsPNG24
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsPNG24
cards.summary: Settings for 24-bit PNG output from Export for Screens: transparency, anti-aliasing, black or white background, interlacing and scale.
use_for: logos and stickers with transparent backgrounds
UI and app assets at 1x/2x/3x
social graphics with crisp type
avoid: photos where file size matters: JPEG or WebP
vector delivery: Web-optimized SVG
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsPNG24(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_PNG24, o, ...).

key_members.name: backgroundBlack
key_members.use: with transparency off, flatten on black (true) or white (false, default)

key_members.name: scaleTypeValue
key_members.use: the factor, width/height in px or resolution, per scaleType (default 1)

gotchas: backgroundBlack only matters when transparency = false
there is no PPI member: size the output with scaleType / scaleTypeValue
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsPNG8
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsPNG8
cards.summary: Settings for 8-bit (indexed) PNG output from Export for Screens: colour count 2-256, transparency, matte colour, interlacing, anti-aliasing and scale.
use_for: small flat-colour icons and logos for the web
favicon-style graphics with few colours
email graphics where size is tight
avoid: gradients, shadows and photos: banding shows; use PNG24 or JPEG
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsPNG8(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_PNG8, o, ...).

key_members.name: matte
key_members.use: matte the artboard with matteColor (default true)

key_members.name: scaleTypeValue
key_members.use: the factor, width/height in px or resolution, per scaleType (default 1)

gotchas: 8-bit transparency is on/off per pixel, so anti-aliased edges take the matte colour: set matteColor to the page background
low colorCount bands gradients
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

review.changes: matte said 'matte soft edges'; harvest says 'Should the artboard be matted with a color'

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsWebOptimizedSVG
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsWebOptimizedSVG
cards.summary: Settings for web-optimised SVG output from Export for Screens: text as SVG text or outlines, coordinate precision, CSS placement, id naming, minify, responsive sizing and how raster images are stored.
use_for: icons and logos for websites and apps
animated or CSS-styled web graphics
small vector assets for developers
avoid: print or editable round-trips: save as .ai / PDF
art full of effects and raster content: PNG
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsWebOptimizedSVG(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_SVG, o, ...).

key_members.name: fontType
key_members.use: SVGFontType: SVGFONT (live text, default) or OUTLINEFONT (text to outlines)

key_members.name: svgMinify
key_members.use: strip whitespace for smaller files (default false)

key_members.name: svgResponsive
key_members.use: drop fixed width/height so the SVG scales to its container (default true)

gotchas: svgResponsive = true removes width/height, so the icon can blow up to its container: set false for fixed-size icons
SVGFONT text depends on the viewer having the font; OUTLINEFONT is safer for logos
SVGIDUNIQUE helps when several SVGs are inlined on one page (unverified that REGULAR collides)
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

cards.name: ExportForScreensOptionsWebP
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensOptionsWebP
cards.summary: Settings for WebP output from Export for Screens: lossless or lossy (quality 0-100), alpha, ICC profile, metadata, anti-aliasing, PPI, matte colour and scale.
use_for: lightweight web images and banners with or without transparency
e-commerce and CMS uploads that accept WebP
avoid: print or editing round-trips
platforms that reject WebP: PNG24 / JPEG
single-file doc.exportFile(file, ExportType.WEBP, ...): that call takes ExportOptionsWebP, not this class
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensOptionsWebP(); set members; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_WEBP, o, ...).

key_members.name: losslessCompression
key_members.use: true (default) = lossless; false = lossy with imageQuality

key_members.name: scaleTypeValue
key_members.use: the factor, width/height in px or resolution, per scaleType (default 1)

gotchas: imageQuality is ignored unless losslessCompression = false
the AVIF options class looks the same but its quality scale is 0-63
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

review.changes: added avoid: exportFile with ExportType.WEBP uses the separate ExportOptionsWebP class

cards.name: ExportForScreensPDFOptions
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportForScreensPDFOptions
cards.summary: Settings for PDF output from Export for Screens: just the name of the Adobe PDF preset to use.
use_for: one PDF per artboard for proofs or print
batch PDF export with a house preset (e.g. PDF/X-4)
avoid: fine-grained PDF control (marks, bleeds, compression one by one): Save As PDF with PDFSaveOptions
cards.how: var o = new ExportForScreensPDFOptions(); o.pdfPreset = "[High Quality Print]"; doc.exportForScreens(folder, ExportForScreensType.SE_PDF, o, ...). Valid names are in app.PDFPresetsList.

key_members.name: pdfPreset
key_members.use: name of an installed Adobe PDF preset (max 255 bytes)

gotchas: the name must match an entry of app.PDFPresetsList exactly, brackets included
which preset is used when pdfPreset is left empty is unverified
options only apply when the matching ExportForScreensType is passed to doc.exportForScreens

cards.name: ExportOptionsAutoCAD
cards.path: File export options classes for Adobe Illustrator/ExportOptionsAutoCAD
cards.summary: Settings for exporting to AutoCAD DWG or DXF: file format, AutoCAD release, units and scale, colour depth, raster format, editability vs appearance, selected art only, outlined text and line-weight scaling.
use_for: sending logos, die-lines or signage paths to CAD, CNC, laser and vinyl-cutting vendors
handing floor-plan or wayfinding art to architects
avoid: art with heavy effects, gradients or transparency: CAD keeps geometry, not appearance
cards.how: var o = new ExportOptionsAutoCAD(); set members; doc.exportFile(File(path), ExportType.AUTOCAD, o).

key_members.name: unit
key_members.use: AutoCADUnit the drawing maps to (default Millimeters)

key_members.name: unitScaleRatio
key_members.use: scale ratio between Illustrator and CAD units (default 1.0)

key_members.name: rasterFormat
key_members.use: AutoCADRasterFormat for raster art: PNG (default) or JPEG

key_members.name: convertTextToOutlines
key_members.use: outline text so CAD needs no fonts (default false)

key_members.name: alterPathsForAppearance
key_members.use: change paths to keep their look, e.g. expand strokes (default false)

key_members.name: scaleLineweights
key_members.use: scale stroke weights with the drawing (default false)

gotchas: check the scale in the CAD app: unit + unitScaleRatio decide real-world size (unverified mapping)
PreserveAppearance may expand or rasterise effects; MaximumEditability keeps paths but drops appearance
older releases (e.g. AutoCADRelease13) for old vendor software lose some features (unverified)
